pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Mock Exam
pro_course_detail.description:
➡️THIS IS MY SPECIALTY! ⬅️

I will give you an IELTS mock speaking exam using the current questions and will give you an IELTS Band score and evaluation.

Please choose the 45-minute lesson. I am required by iTalki to offer a 60-minute lesson, but I don't want you to choose it. That's why it's so much more expensive than my 45-minute lesson. I want to be able to have a short break between classes. 

45-Minute Mock Exam Lesson: The lesson will follow this format: 1) I will get some information from you; 2) I'll give you the mock exam using the current questions. 3) I'll tell you your speaking score for all four areas and the total speaking score; 4) I'll tell you what you need to do to improve; 5) We'll have some time at the end for me to point out some of the mistakes you made. 6) There is always time for you to ask me questions. 

Please choose a time that starts on the hour (for example: 8:00) and not a time that starts on the half hour.

PLEASE NOTE that I don't usually use the video function when I teach. I don't need to see you, only hear you. I prefer to teach using my phone, which I hold in my hand and sometimes put down on my desk. I don't want to make you feel like you are on a boat in the ocean when I'm giving you a lesson! The only time I use the video is if you insist that you need to see me so that it feels more like a real exam. If this is your situation, please let me know in advance so I can be prepared. 

If you are from China I will send you a message asking you to add me on WeChat. I prefer using WeChat with Chinese students. If you are not from China I prefer to use the iTalki classroom.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation Lessons (For Band 6.5 or Higher Only)
pro_course_detail.description:
My main focus is giving mock IELTS exams. However, I will accept two or three students at a time for IELTS preparation lessons. You must have a mock exam with me before I will accept you as an IELTS Prep student.

Please choose a time that starts on the hour (for example: 8:00) and not a time that starts on the half hour.

I accept students for IELTS preparation who need to make a Band 6.5 or higher.

Here's the bad news: I only accept students who I think I can help! For example, if you have serious grammar or pronunciation problems, you need a teacher who is better in those areas than I am. Yes, I can find the problems (I have a very good ear, since I was an IELTS examiner), but I'm not good at correcting them. More bad news: I only accept students who have already had one of my mock exam lessons. That way I know what your band score is and if I am the right person to help you reach your goal score.

Please choose the 45-minute lesson or 90-minute lesson. I am required by iTalki to offer a 60-minute lesson, but I don't want you to choose it. That's why it's so much more expensive than my 45-minute lesson. I want to be able to have a short break between classes. The 90-minute lesson will be like two 45-minute lessons, with a break in the middle.

pro_course_detail.title: Combo Lesson: IELTS Mock Exam and IELTS Preparation Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Choose this 90-minute Combo Lesson if you want to have an IELTS mock exam with me and then, after a short break, have an IELTS preparation lesson. The advantage of this combo lesson is that we can immediately start working on the problem areas that I find in the mock exam. 

For the first 45 minutes I will give you a mock exam and evaluation. We'll take about a ten-minute break, then come back and have an IELTS preparation lesson. In this lesson I'll focus on the weak areas that I found when I gave you a mock exam. 

I normally only accept IELTS preparation students who need a Band 6.5 or higher, but for this Combo Lesson, I'll accept anyone. 

iTalki requires their teachers to offer a 60-minute lesson; however, I can't do a mock exam and prep lesson in only an hour. Please don't choose the 60-minute lesson, only the 90-minute one.

I don't offer trial lessons. However, I will give you a 25% discount for your first class, so you can see if we are a good fit. This discount is only available for the 45-minute lesson.

course_info.trial_description:
Need an effective teacher who easily explains step by step?

This is a chance to practice your English skills, for me to assess your level, and for you to get an idea of my teaching style. 

You must be at least 6.5 years old for my class. For young beginners, we will introduce each other first, and l will teach you some common etiquette when meeting someone. Then I will show you some pictures where I will ask you some questions about them. I will also teach you  how to ask for help when you don' understand a word or don't have an answer. Next you will read  a short picture story with more question and answer time. Here I will get an an idea of your grammar experience and comprehension level. After that, we will play a learning game for you to learn some new vocabulary and demonstrate more speaking. Last, I will review the 44 sounds of the English language to see what sounds you are having trouble pronouncing. At the end, parents and I can meet to talk about strengths, weaknesses, and the best learning plan as well as further discounts.

If you are older we can talk and learn about anything you want or I will choose the topics.

Whether you are  a young or an adult, I will correct and explain all errors both verbally and in writing.

* SKYPE or Italki *  ( for 6.5-14 years old) This is an elementary level course  for kids who already know some phonics and can read short sentences. The goal is to build a strong  foundation to easily understand and speak on everyday topics for functioning in English-speaking cultures.

Conversations may include food, travel, school, hobbies, chores, dreams,  technology, trends, entertainment, health, traditions, shopping, pop culture, and more.

- Play fun learning games
- Master the 44 sounds of English for clear pronunciation
- Learn the 12 past, present, and future tenses
- Express experiences and opinions
- Compare and contrast
- Summarize short videos
- Recognize spelling patterns
- Write well-written informative essays and creative stories
- Give show-and-tell presentations
- Take quizzes
- Do optional homework

If your goal is to  consistently improve your English,  make sure to schedule lessons regularly.

Engagement and frequency are the secrets to mastering English, and I will be there to help your child along.

pro_course_detail.title: The Simple Outline for Writing in English
pro_course_detail.description:
Create an informal but very useful outline for any writing project in English: emails,  essays, articles, speeches, work memos and more . A good outline helps you remember all the thoughts you want to write. This is especially true when you write in English which has such a huge vocabulary.

And no one is going to see your outline except you.  So, you don't have to be neat, put it onto a specific format, or concentrate on spelling or grammar.  An outline will benefit you no matter what your English level -  from intermediate to proficient.

In this class you'll learn:
*How to get over the dread of doing an outline.
* Why an outline works a lot better then memorizing ideas and details.
*The difference between a informal and academic outline.
* The wonderful fact that you don't have to follow your outline to successfully write. You can change your mind about what to write - or you can change your outline.

We'll start right away on your outline.  First you'll pick your writing topic.  Next, you'll write down your thoughts about what you want to communicate in your writing.  If you can't think of anything to write about, I'll interview you to find out your interests.  We'll then turn your outline into to a real piece of writing that you can use.

Class Expectations:
1. Keep a flexible mind when writing an outline and be open to ideas from me,  your teacher.
2. At the same time, prepare to write independently after a couple of sessions.
3. Expect homework on writing outlines or changing outlines into the final writing project.
4. Ask questions!

I look forward to having you in my class.

teacher_info.introduction: In university, I completed a minor in German. Many of my friends were international students, often with limited English skills. I took pride in my ability to adapt my language to the appropriate level as they progressed. I learned Esperanto by email, but very soon my wife and I got involved with the community. We regularly sought opportunities to speak face to face. In a short time, the people I considered my mentors were seeking my input on how to express fine shades of meaning. Through two decades, I have seen a broad range of backgrounds. Different explanations work for different people. Some aspects need more attention. Some common explanations are actually best avoided. Since Esperanto was our home language, I have accumulated songs, games, and other methods that are suitable for younger children. M y 11 year old son and I created a course. I volunteer with the boy scouts, teaching and mentoring boys from 6-17. Through organizing Esperanto events, I have the opportunity to work with both beginners and more experienced self-learners who find themselves speaking Esperanto for the first time. This can be scary, but we've all been there. I can help you over these jitters, and to move beyond translating phrases to actively thinking in the language. This is an exciting time for Esperanto. New technology allows us not only to read and write, but for conversation as well. You need a teacher with experience actually speaking the language. It's good to start with good pronunciation, but it's never too late. NOTE FOR ENGLISH LEARNERS: Although my profile emphasizes other languages, I want you to know that I take teaching English seriously. I teach English locally and work with students from total beginner to near-native - ages 8 to 80. I will encourage you to work on your communication skills and being understood. I will also provide feedback on one or two things you can work on. I invite you to read the comments by others who have learned English with me.
